svg.title: Concept illustration: rotator connection box mounted to a Rohn 25G tower leg
svg.desc: A weather-resistant enclosure mounted on a steel plate, held to one tower leg by two vertically spaced U-bolts. The box has illustrative sealed multi-pin bulkhead connectors. Product dimensions, connector count, pinout, ratings, and mounting dimensions must be verified before fabrication.
svg.text: Concept assembly · enclosure on a steel mounting plate, clamped to a Rohn 25G tower leg

text.tspan: Plate is shown against one tower leg; two spaced clamps
wrap the leg, with threaded ends, washers, and nuts securing
the plate. Verify leg diameter, U-bolt fit, plate thickness,
clearance, and wind-load adequacy before fabrication.
Closed lid with perimeter seam and fasteners; stainless
hardware and a compatible gasket are illustrated. Confirm
the enclosure material, dimensions, UV resistance, sealing,
and mounting provisions from the selected product.
Contact face, count, series, pinout, and ratings are symbolic
mating gender, seals, and cable range are TBD. Confirm the
exact connector variant and installation instructions; fit
strain relief and drip loops on exterior cables.

svg.text: Serviceable exterior cable connection · replaceable cable assemblies · protected, strain-relieved entries

g.text: No dimensions or electrical ratings are represented as verified.
